what_this_is: The ONE full broad migration audit this order pays for changing how the whole-site assembler resolves a registered market's final partition. It validates the ASSEMBLER LOOKUP CHANGE; it is not part of an ordinary registration.
targeted_tests_complete_before_start: the 15-module targeted set at the audited commit: 4 failed / 750 passed / 4 skipped, and the SAME four fail at the parent ce5c2502 (identical node-id sets, TRUE_NEW 0)
baseline_policy: regression_lanes.classify against regression_baselines/f75aa95.json by node id (the committed baseline policy), then failure-set IDENTITY against the audited parent's own broad run (PTF-FINAL-FRESH-MARKET-REGISTRATION-REENGINEERING-001 migration-audit-final-001 at 091242a4, 167 failing)

the_one_true_new_node.mechanism: The test greps the assembler's SOURCE for the table entry as a dict literal. This order removed the table from the assembler; Toledo's entry now lives in market_partition_resolution.LEGACY_PARTITION_TABLE as a tuple pair, so the literal string is absent and the assertion is false.
the_one_true_new_node.is_the_behaviour_it_protects_still_true: YES, and proven three independent ways: market_partition_resolution resolves toledo-oh to toledo_oh_final_partition_001.json (pinned by name in the resolver's own test's FROZEN_LEGACY table); the whole-site control build at this audited commit is byte-identical to live production across all 5524 files, Toledo's 17 profiles included; and the resolution report records toledo-oh as LEGACY_TABLE, never UNRESOLVED.
the_one_true_new_node.what_repairing_it_would_be: a TEST_EXPECTATION_CHANGE: point the assertion at the resolver's frozen table instead of the assembler's source text
the_one_true_new_node.why_it_was_not_repaired: Phase 8 of this order forbids any post-audit code or test correction and forbids a second broad audit. The correction was NOT made and no second audit was run.

DID_AUDIT_REQUIRE_POST_AUDIT_CODE_CHANGE: YES -- one stale test expectation. Under this order's Phase 8 rule that is FINAL ENGINEERING ATTEMPT = FAIL.
